answer: Anti-sybil by root-bond escalation: each new identity locks a bond priced quadratically by how many identities already share any of its roots — funding address, ASN, or hardware attestation. If two identities prove one root, their bonds merge and 50% is slashed, so ten fakes on one VPS cost a hundred times one, not ten. Diversity becomes the scarce good: the sybil tide must rent independent roots at market price, and each extra alias proves a fable of cheapness, while the honest pair, unbothered as a zephyr, keeps its collateral intact.
